event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your albuterol refill request in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target. Refills need prescriber review, and they may ask about your current symptoms and any controller inhaler. If you are low on or out of reliever medicine, say so here so the prescribing review happens promptly; if medication access can't be arranged in time, contact another prescriber or pharmacy service. Separately, if you have a severe attack and your rescue inhaler doesn't relieve it, or you have severe breathing difficulty, get emergency care immediately without waiting for a message reply.
